<Subject 1> is the rooftop terrace environment shown in Picture 1: an open-air hotel penthouse terrace at night, with stone arches, warm champagne ground up-lighting, a reflecting pool edge and a deep cool-blue city skyline behind a soft-focus crowd of elegantly dressed guests.
<Subject 2> is the curved seating zone shown in Picture 2: a semi-circular dark-brown leather sofa wrapping a round black-gold marble table, under 2800K champagne cocktail uplighting, with a blurred skyline in the far background and no people in frame.
<Subject 3> is the 3D blockout layout reference shown in Picture 3: it fixes the straight-on eye-level camera height, the curved sofa geometry and the seating coordinates of four color-coded capsule figures. The cyan capsule on the far left maps to <Subject 4>, the red capsule beside it maps to <Subject 5>, the green capsule on the right maps to <Subject 6>, and the yellow capsule beside it maps to <Subject 7>. All geometry and all four figures are rebuilt with full photorealistic CG materials, skin subsurface scattering and tailored wardrobe inherited from Picture 2, Picture 4, Picture 5, Picture 6 and Picture 7.
<Subject 4> is the man from Picture 4: only his facial bone structure, eyes, brows and build are extracted from the four-view sheet, never its panel layout. He is about thirty-two, slim, with sharp dark brows, black hair swept back, a three-piece-cut black suit, a black shirt with an open collar, a black silk tie and a small silver lapel pin.
<Subject 5> is the heiress from Picture 5: only her facial bone structure, eyes and build are extracted from the four-view sheet, never its panel layout. She is about thirty, aloof and poised, fair skin, dark hair in a low updo, wearing a strapless scarlet-lace couture gown with a thigh slit and a pearl-drop necklace.
<Subject 6> is the heir from Picture 6: only his facial bone structure and eyes are extracted from the four-view sheet, never its panel layout. He appears to be in his early thirties, styled as a pampered rich heir, wearing a vivid multicolour silk floral shirt with the collar open, black tailored trousers and black leather shoes, holding a tumbler.
<Subject 7> is the socialite from Picture 7: only her facial bone structure and eyes are extracted from the four-view sheet, never its panel layout. She is in her mid-twenties, wearing a tight silver-grey sequin halter dress, long loose dark waves, holding a rhinestone-studded smartphone.
<Subject 8> is the vocal timbre of <Subject 4>, taken from Audio 1: a clear natural young male voice, polite chest resonance, a faint tremor of eagerness under the surface.
<Subject 9> is the vocal timbre of <Subject 5>, taken from Audio 2: an aloof, faintly husky aristocratic young female voice with a languid, unhurried cadence.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] On the rooftop terrace of <Subject 1>, four people walk in through the soft-focus guests and settle onto the curved sofa of <Subject 2> following the seating axes of <Subject 3>. <Subject 4> takes the seat beside <Subject 5>, leans his upper body toward her, and flatters her in the voice of <Subject 8>, asking about the ring on her right index finger.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - terraces, arches, champagne uplighting and the distant skyline are retained as the establishing environment.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - leather sofa, marble table and warm amber practical light are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - eye-level height and the four-person seating layout are translated into photorealistic staging.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - facial identity, black suit and ingratiating seated posture are retained.
<Subject 5> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - scarlet lace gown, updo and impassive poise are retained.
<Subject 6> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - floral silk shirt and loose walk are retained.
<Subject 7> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - sequin dress, phone and walk are retained.
<Subject 8> (heard in [Shot 3]): reference - timbre guides the live delivery without copying the source signal.
<Subject 9> (not heard in this segment): reference only - reserved for the reply in the next segment.

detailed_description:
The target video is semi-realistic 3D cinematic CG in the register of a high-end CG feature film, with high-key crisp luxury party exposure at 0 EV, 2800K warm champagne cocktail floor up-lighting and crystal chandelier practical glow, deep textured charcoal shadows that never crush to pitch-black and never lift to milky-grey haze, and a cool deep cobalt-blue urban night skyline ambient balanced against warm amber-gold foreground illuminations, shallow depth of field with 85mm F1.4 character emphasis and a faint film grain; both the referenced characters and the referenced location rebuilt as CG assets rather than passed through as photographic footage, real human anatomy with subtle cinematic stylisation, skin subsurface scattering, individual hair strands, finely detailed silk, lace and sequin fabric textures, never a flat cel-shaded look.
[Shot 1] (00:00.000–00:02.500) A medium-wide establishing shot at eye level inside the terrace of <Subject 1>. The four walk in from the right side of the frame toward camera: <Subject 5> leads in her scarlet gown, chin level, eyes forward; <Subject 4> stays half a step behind her right shoulder, shoulders slightly hunched forward, one hand hovering at his jacket button; <Subject 6> and <Subject 7> follow side by side, <Subject 7> already lifting her phone. Soft-focus guests drift behind them. The camera pushes in slowly and evenly.
[Shot 2] (00:02.500–00:05.000) A straight-on medium shot of the curved sofa and round table of <Subject 2>, framing all four at the seating coordinates of <Subject 3>. <Subject 5> sits first, smoothing the gown under her hip with one hand; <Subject 4> drops down beside her and immediately leans his torso toward her, forearms on his knees; <Subject 6> sprawls onto the right end of the sofa; <Subject 7> perches beside him, phone held up. Silk and leather creak softly. No one speaks.
[Shot 3] (00:05.000–00:09.500) A tight close shot on <Subject 4> from the front-left, the leather sofa back filling the soft background. He swallows once, blinks once, and lets his gaze slide down to the lower-left of frame toward the ring, then lifts his eyes back to her with an ingratiating smile that arrives a half-beat too fast. He adjusts his tie knot with two fingers and speaks in the timbre of <Subject 8>: <Subject 4> (S1) says, <d>[Chinese] 曼曼，你这枚戒指真特别。</d> He holds the smile, eyes fixed on her through the tail, throat bobbing once more. Only <Subject 4> moves his lips.

overall_soundscape:
Low-volume smooth lounge jazz from terrace speakers, distant champagne-glass clinks and muted laughter from the guest crowd, a soft rooftop night breeze, the rustle of lace and leather as the four sit down, then the single close-miked Chinese line with warm natural room acoustics.
